p.src: 1  The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

ja: をまとわれた！ 主は力をまとい、それを
en: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
u.src: 1  The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

p.src: 2  Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

ja: っている。 あなたは
en: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
u.src: 2  Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

p.src: 3  The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

en: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
u.src: 3  The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

p.src: 4  Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

ja: にもまさって、 高き所におられる主は
en: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
u.src: 4  Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

p.src: 5  Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

ja: あなたの定めは堅く立っている。
を飾る。 主よ、とこしえに。
en: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
u.src: 5  Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
